title: Zeus Juice Mortals - Keewibera 100ml shortfill E-Liquid
description: Keewibera from Zeus Juice’s Mortals collection is a perfectly balanced blend of rich and sweet strawberries and tangy tropical kiwi for a sumptuous fruit base, all wrapped in a classic, fruity, retro bubblegum. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
